candidates: When a GitHub Actions tool that has a dedicated config-validator workflow (e.g., `pr-labeler-config-validator.yml`) is replaced or removed, also delete the validator workflow — running validation for a config format that is no longer in use has no value and clutters CI. For `release-drafter/release-drafter` specifically, the tool reads its configuration exclusively from the repository's default branch (not from the PR branch), so PR-time config validation is impossible and should not be added.
